registration_timing: Registered after the post-result rounding and threshold-surface audits, but before implementation, simulation, or inspection of any known-truth pilot outcome.
purpose: Debug a known-truth operating-characteristic design for raw CMLE-WLE Person MnSq rules while separating Person-fit threshold behavior from structural-calibration estimation, anchor identification, and cross-engine estimand differences.

phase_a_estimand.label: oracle_structural_calibration_plus_fit_sample_WLE_person_fit
phase_a_estimand.primary_person_measure: Warm WLE estimated from the same retained responses with the working calibration fixed
phase_a_estimand.secondary_person_measure: generating theta, labelled oracle-theta sensitivity only
phase_a_estimand.calibration_role: fixed known working RSM calibration; no structural parameters are refitted
phase_a_estimand.what_phase_a_isolates: sampling and misspecification behavior of Person-fit rules conditional on fixed calibration

simulation_constants.working_model: RSM with unit difficulty equal to rater plus criterion effect and common category thresholds
simulation_constants.administration_selection: For sparse conditions, sample the frozen number of distinct units without replacement independently by Person; retain sorted unit order for response generation.
simulation_constants.common_random_numbers: Conditions sharing SeedGroup use separate deterministic substreams for theta, administration, baseline response uniforms, affected-Person selection, and contamination so paired mechanisms reuse the same latent draws and baseline uniforms.
simulation_constants.affected_person_selection: A deterministic random 25% of Persons for non-clean conditions, shared within SeedGroup and replicate.

decision_contract.endpoint_semantics: MnSq below overfit_upper is overfit; exact overfit_upper through exact acceptable_upper are acceptable; above acceptable_upper through exact noisy_upper are noisy; above noisy_upper is distorting.

rules.either_nonacceptable: Infit < overfit_upper or Infit > acceptable_upper or Outfit < overfit_upper or Outfit > acceptable_upper

threshold_surface.source: Reuse exactly the already frozen 125-triplet grid; do not extend or select it after outcomes.

aggregation_contract.primary_summary: mean replicate-specific rate with empirical between-replicate SD and SD/sqrt(number of available replicates)
aggregation_contract.pooled_person_rate: descriptive only; never attach an independent-binomial Wilson interval
aggregation_contract.failed_or_unavailable_person_fit: retain in attempted and unavailable denominators; never count as an unflagged decision

figures: canonical false-positive and affected-person detection rates by condition

anchor_and_connectivity_boundary.phase_b_requirement: Add and independently validate a native CMLE anchor/offset contract before varying anchor proportion or contamination. Separately vary missingness graphs and reject conditional-rank failures before fitting.
anchor_and_connectivity_boundary.must_not_substitute: Do not emulate anchors by post-hoc recentering or by relabelling a fixed oracle calibration as estimated anchored CMLE.

cross_engine_boundary.next_registered_extension: Fit the identical retained generated bytes with supported estimands only: Python/immer CMLE where unanchored and conditionally identified, mfrmr JMLE, TAM MML, and sirt MML. Preserve estimator labels and unsupported rows.
